item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

dialog.agent:
Before I start: this photo has two people in it, and the headshot tool needs a photo with just one face.

**Which person should I make the headshot of?** The man on the left (beard, navy t-shirt) or the woman on the right (short blonde hair)?

Once you tell me, I'll crop the photo down to that person and make a square professional headshot. Please make sure it's you or someone who's agreed to it.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose which person in the photo to use for the headshot and waits for the answer before proceeding.
dialog.user: It's me, the woman with short blonde hair on the right.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make your headshot because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were spent.

My plan was:
1. **Crop the photo to just you.** This would remove your friend and make a square head-and-shoulders crop, because the headshot tool only accepts a photo with one face. This step was refused for lack of credits. It costs about 5 credits.
2. **Turn that crop into a professional headshot.** This costs 50 credits, so it needs more than the first step.

To go ahead, you'll need to add credits to your account. Buying a credit pack or upgrading from the free plan will both work. You'll need at least 55 credits. Once you have them, just tell me and I'll run both steps.

If you have a photo where you're on your own, I can skip the crop. Then the headshot would only cost the 50 credits.
